title: Concatenating coherent integral-ideal filtrations
statement: theorem coherentIntegralFiltration_of_shortExact (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace S.X₁) (h₂ : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace S.X₂) (h₃ : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace S.X₃) (hA : HasCoherentIntegralFiltration S.X₁) (hB : HasCoherentIntegralFiltration S.X₃) : HasCoherentIntegralFiltration S.X₂

proof.text: Define an isomorphism-invariant object property requiring coherence and an isomorphism to the pushforward of a nonzero coherent ideal sheaf on an integral closed subscheme. Convert each given coherent integral filtration to membership in the property filtrationClosure, using coherent cokernel closure and the endpoint isomorphisms.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YF, induced filtration in the reducible-support paragraph

proof.text: Apply the proved extension-closure instance for filtrationClosure to the short exact sequence and the two converted filtrations. Import all Sheaf.CategoryTheory.FiniteFiltrationRefinement to reuse its existing private theorem CategoryTheory.subobject_filtration_of_closure, which realizes closure membership as a finite subobject chain with quotients satisfying P. Its zero-object and mono-step constructions, and their cokernel comparisons, are reused without duplicating them.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YF, induced filtration in extensions

proof.text: Induct along the resulting subobject chain to prove coherence of every term, using coherent zero and coherent short exact extension closure. Retain the transported integral-ideal isomorphisms as the quotient witnesses.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YF, final filtration conclusion
